about: RIG v3: the CC0 soldier (Irondust) + five CC0 guns (quaternius), posed on the sim's shot line, toon-reduced in the concept boards' khaki/rust (decisions entry 27). Built by tools/art/build_rig_v3.py; not wired into the game yet (T-124 phase 2).
mirror: cells face +x; mirror about origin.x when the gun points left (aim.x < -0.1) or, for a vertical aim, when the sim facing is -1 (player.js mirrorY). Travelling against the gun (strafe): play the run cycle backwards.
sample: NEAREST, no mipmaps, unlit (palette-exact pixels); place origin on the projected sim point, snapped to the device pixel grid
units: anchors in tiles from the sim point (x right, y up); px = origin + (x, -y) * pxPerTile

R.looks: long chunky bullpup block, rust lower body (the model's MainLight parts)

S.looks: long twin tube (barrel over magazine tube), short rust stock, orange pump

L.looks: long thin rifle (barrel x2 thick past the fore-end), folding stock, cyan scope

H.looks: tall boxy SMG, long pink magazine

F.looks: bulky bullpup block, orange vertical foregrip

stand-fire.note: the 105 ms kick after a shot (src/pure/rig.js RIG_RECOIL_MS) while standing

wall.note: player.js: climb-2 when traversalSide < 0, else climb-0

serves: x1: 1280x720 css desktop FAR at DPR 1 (16.24 px/tile, measured)
x2: 720 css px tall at DPR 2, or 1440 css px tall at DPR 1 (32.5)
x3: 2160 css px tall at DPR 1 (48.7)
x1: phone landscape, RIG 6% of 390 css px (T-107 framing) at DPR 2 (23.4)
x1: 1920x1080 desktop FAR at DPR 1 needs 24.4 -- d23 draws RIG 4% small there
x1: phone landscape, RIG 6% of 390 css px (T-107 framing) at DPR 3 (35.1): the operator's iPhone
